title: Design Decision Matrix
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Decision Matrix
Design Trade-Offs
Engineering Design
Sensitivity Analysis
description: Interactive p5.js weighted decision matrix for comparing up to four clock designs: weight sliders, 1-5 score menus, a bar chart of weighted totals with the winner highlighted, presets including the chapter's worked example, and a sensitivity check that finds the weight change that would flip the winner.

educational.topic: Weighted decision matrices for design choices
learningObjectives: Evaluate competing clock designs with a weighted decision matrix
Justify a choice by naming the weights that decide it
Judge whether a decision is robust or would flip with a small change in priorities

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Evaluation with a rubric and a robustness check
keyQuestions: How much would your priorities have to change before another design wins?
Why can two students reach different answers from the same scores?
commonMisconceptions: The design with the most top scores always wins (weights can override them)
A decision matrix gives the one right answer (it explains a choice for a given set of priorities)
assessmentOpportunities: Write a justification that cites the sensitivity result

controls.label: Sensitivity
controls.description: Reports the smallest single weight change that would make another design tie or win.
